title.narrative: 2: Percentage share of samples of food/beverages in which violation of standards were observed during National Food Agency (NFA) monitoring checks

description.narrative: Percentage share of samples of food/beverages in which violation of standards were observed during NFA monitoring checks. NFA plans monitoring checks every year based on the number of violations occurred during the previous years monitoring checks. The type of the producers for checks and frequency/sample size is also defined based on the number of violations discovered previous year for each type of producers. More violations found during the year, means more monitoring checks will be planned for the next year. During monitoring checks samples of food/beverages are taken to the laboratory and checked for different parameters such as: Brucellosis, Sanitary control over several parameters (mesophilic aerobic and facultative anaerobic microorganisms, Escherichia coli, Pathogens incl. salmonella, shigella, Drinking water (organoleptic/microbiological pollution), Alcohol sweetness/acidity etc. The indicator is calculated as following: total number of samples with violations / total number of samples taken.

comment.narrative: In 2023 the National Food Agency Food Safety Competent Authority took 5801 samples of food and beverages in accordance with their relevant procedures and tested them at the laboratory. Violations were identified in 13 of them
